batch_node.description: Seeds a Schedule that runs the FedRAMP 20x KSI Catalog collector once per day at 00:00 UTC. The SCHEDULED_TARGET edge points at the KSI catalog collector entity (UUIDv5 derived from its registry scope:key per req-tap-cares-collector-model-10). Schedules are user-creatable per req-tap-cares-scheduler-model-6, so this is a normal node create, not an INTERNAL_ONLY trusted-internal write.
